interpretation.denominator: Publisher's latest per-endpoint paid-verification attempt; 7,675 asked for payment, 82 not applicable; not a random sample of all agent APIs.
interpretation.meaning: About 65.9% delivered under this competitor's paid probe and client conditions. Non-delivery includes endpoint issues, missing parameters, probe/client limitations and settlement ambiguity; it is not a verified seller failure rate or customer-loss estimate.
interpretation.commercial_boundary: These are competitor-operated purchases and publisher claims, not independent buyers, AgentMine customers, revenue, observed supplier task savings or willingness to pay.
interpretation.competitive_implication: A competing directory already publishes real paid-delivery checks, on-chain receipts and a pre-spend verification interface. Generic endpoint quality scoring/routing is not an uncontested AgentMine wedge.
caveats: The last paid attempt timestamp predates retrieval; avoid asserting current live delivery.
Publisher methodology reports corrections to settlement and timeout labels; do not treat all non-delivered attempts as settled payments or vendor fault.
No AgentMine paid API calls, customer contact, deployment, credentials or private data were used.
